risks.proof: Close-up shot of the edge or cross-section showing thickness and material composition, or a test for aluminium (e.g., magnet test, density check).
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower-grade or non-aluminium material, which would reduce value significantly.

risks.risk: surface coating is damaged or peeling, leading to premature corrosion
risks.proof: Close-up of the surface under bright light, especially along the ribs and valleys, to check for chipping, flaking, or discoloration.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially defective or with reduced lifespan.

risks.risk: sheets are not uniform in size or thickness, affecting installation and durability

proof_requests: Close-up of the edge or cross-section of the sheet to verify material and thickness.
Close-up of the surface under bright light to check for coating integrity.
Measurement of length, width, and thickness of at least two sheets to confirm uniformity.
Photo of a magnet test on the sheet to confirm it is non-ferrous (aluminium).
